panel_53e5555e9a.message: Stores replay data locally while redacting secret-bearing fields and sensitive inputs. Ordinary typed text and action results remain available for replay. MCP clients can save a local task memory by providing a secret-free completion, partial, or failure summary; no separate AI-provider call is made. Turning this off stops future MCP recording and saves any open recording. Existing MCP replay history stores up to the 50 most recent sessions, and no session is kept longer than the configured retention period. Autopilot history is unaffected.
